acceptanceCriteria: Every one of WI-647, WI-648, WI-649, WI-650 is summarized with its actual measured before/after numbers (not restated claims) and a link to its own Work Item doc.

The streaming-hash and bounded-parallel-read P1 candidates are evaluated against actual measured data from this repository (inspect filesRead/filesHashed counts, largest tracked file sizes) and a documented decision (pursue or decline) is recorded with that evidence.

IncrementalMerkle and PhysicalSingleFlightCoordinator are confirmed, by direct source inspection recorded in this document, to have no non-test production caller; the decision not to wire them in without a concrete measured concurrent-duplication or cache-correctness need is recorded explicitly, not silently assumed.

P3 candidates (resident MCP cache, in-process git, PGO) are recorded as not pursued because no P0-P2 measurement in this initiative identified a bottleneck they would address, with the specific reasoning stated rather than a blanket deferral.

The document states outstanding P0 scope explicitly not completed (8-scenario fixture matrix, phase-level resource-metric exposure on status/doctor/observe, persistent-MCP measurement, identity-tolerant dev comparator) as known gaps, not silently dropped.
goal: Deliver a single reference document that inventories the four delivered Work Items (WI-647..650), their measured before/after evidence, and a decision plus supporting measurement for each remaining P1-P3 candidate, so a future contributor has a verified starting point instead of re-deriving the same measurements.
intent: Close out the AI Cockpit performance initiative (P0-P3) with an evidence-based synthesis: for every remaining candidate that was not implemented (P1 streaming hash/bounded parallel read, P2 request dedup/IncrementalMerkle caching, P3 resident cache/in-process git/PGO), record the measurement that was actually taken and why it does not currently justify implementation, rather than mechanically implementing every candidate.
outOfScope: Implementing any of the P1-P3 candidates this document declines; each remains available for a future measured Work Item if new evidence justifies it
